$comment: Engagement offers shown on /engage and /twins. Prices are USD starting points.

engagements.name: Fixed-scope Delivery Sprint
engagements.summary: One outcome, one price: a cloud-cost cut, a platform migration, a ClickHouse or IIoT ingestion path, or a production AI-agent pilot.

engagements.name: Digital Twin Pilot
engagements.summary: A physics-informed live twin of one plant system, connected to your BMS or gateway data, with fault detection and energy accounting.
includes: Data audit and point mapping (BACnet, Modbus, MQTT)
Physics model of the asset, calibrated on your data
Live isometric twin with health and fault views
Energy-loss report against a healthy baseline

engagements.name: Technical Advisor
engagements.summary: A senior sounding board for founders and engineering leaders: architecture decisions, vendor choices and hiring loops.

engagements.name: Fractional CTO
engagements.summary: Accountable technical leadership without a full-time hire: roadmap, architecture ownership, team and board narrative.
includes: Systems architecture and cloud cost ownership
Stack, cloud and LLM provider decisions

engagements.name: Embedded Architecture & Build
engagements.summary: Near full-time senior leadership that also builds: platform shifts, private AI infrastructure and production incidents.
includes: Private LLM gateways and agent pipelines
